observations.evidence: Main crop: compact repeated n/e strokes and a crossed x belong to connexe; no tall t or final ou/r sequence. Underlining retained.
observations.decision: Main inspected the indicated crop; retain the stated reading from visible ink.

observations.evidence: Main crop: two short high quote ticks at each end and two equality strokes. No third equality stroke or angle-shaped guillemet. Glyph differences, not equivalent LaTeX notation.
observations.decision: Main inspected the indicated crop; retain the stated reading from visible ink.

observations.evidence: Crop: one continuous bent digit with a short rightward foot; no detached question-mark point below.
observations.decision: Main inspected the indicated crop; retain the stated reading from visible ink.

observations.place: End of second manuscript line, after S comma
observations.evidence: Two separated low strokes: a short rounded first trace and a longer returning second trace. Compressed ou is favoured, but loop closure is insufficient to exclude dash-like marks.
observations.decision: New doubt added to C after main crop inspection; alternatives remain visible possibilities.

observations.place: Start of third manuscript line, between A and choix
observations.evidence: Two short low traces, unlike the single horizontal dash after choix. Compressed au is primary, but the traces remain too flat to exclude a dash reading. Choix itself is readable.
observations.decision: New doubt added to C after main crop inspection; alternatives remain visible possibilities.

observations.evidence: Main crop shows an open descending left entry and a flat right shoulder; no secure closed counter. This favours r over sigma, but the small compressed glyph remains ambiguous.
observations.decision: Choose R2 primary r; retain R1/R3 sigma as the alternative. No formula expectation used.

observations.place: First raised circle-like glyph on G, recurring in list
observations.evidence: A small nearly round open loop. Shape and scale do not distinguish zero from small circle. Only the first occurrence is marked; subsequent G superscripts use primary 0.
observations.decision: Main inspected the indicated crop; retain the stated reading from visible ink.

observations.place: Subscript on u at end of first paragraph
observations.evidence: Two lower lobes are rounded and the right end curls inward/upward; omega rather than angular Latin w.
observations.decision: Main inspected the indicated crop; retain the stated reading from visible ink.

observations.evidence: Main crop: the single underline begins beneath the latter part of contour and continues beneath connexe. Difference is underline scope, not underline/emphasis macro syntax.
observations.decision: Main inspected the indicated crop; retain the stated reading from visible ink.

observations.evidence: Crop: g descender and very compressed angular remainder; a separate r is undecidable, while full ou is not visible. Preserve abbreviation.
observations.decision: Main inspected the indicated crop; retain the stated reading from visible ink.

observations.place: Paragraphing of introduction to numbered data
observations.reading: Se donner un \uline{contour connexe} équivaut : la donnée de
observations.evidence: Main crop shows the colon at the end of the first line and la donnée de at the ordinary next-line spacing, returning to the left edge. No separate indented or spaced paragraph begins there.
observations.decision: All three readers keep the introduction as one paragraph; main crop confirms. H introduces an unsupported paragraph break.

observations.place: Item 2°, cancellation between une and partie
observations.evidence: Horizontal strike crosses short group. First e-like curl and following small rises favour ens, but lower parts are covered and un remains possible.
observations.decision: Main inspected the indicated crop; retain the stated reading from visible ink.

observations.evidence: Continuous cancellation runs from f through final tall d; the detached apostrophe belongs to that d. The next live de is separately visible to the right.
observations.decision: Main inspected the indicated crop; retain the stated reading from visible ink.

observations.place: Item 2°, live continuation after long cancellation
observations.evidence: After clear live de, one hooked glyph ends the line before next-line forme. Its compressed shape permits la or 2. No additional full word or separately repeated de la is visible. Grammatical expectation does not resolve the glyph.
observations.decision: R1 retains la|2; R2 and R3 resolve la. Main sees a single hooked glyph after clear de, without a securely separate a: retain la|2.

observations.evidence: Main crop: the low horizontal return at the start is continuous with the initial g descender, with no independent underline under the word.
observations.decision: Main inspected the indicated crop; retain the stated reading from visible ink.

observations.place: Second letter in the pair with exponent minus one
observations.evidence: Main crop: first g has a conspicuous long descender. The second base has a short upper hook and lower return, with no comparable descender, favouring s; compressed g remains possible.
observations.decision: Main keeps s|g, with s first from the ink. Expected inverse-pair mathematics cannot select g.

observations.evidence: Much smaller writing below item 2° and above full-sized item 3°: an interlinear insertion attached to the generator clause, not a new item. Word-level differences are recorded separately.
observations.decision: All three place the smaller parenthesis between items 2 and 3 as an insertion. Main crop confirms size and location. Word-level differences are counted in separate rows.

observations.evidence: Tall d survives; following low trace is compressed almost flat. Donc is favoured, while des remains allowed. C’s doubt retained with explicit alternative.
observations.decision: Main inspected the indicated crop; retain the stated reading from visible ink.

observations.evidence: Crop ends word with small e before separate de; no additional s.

observations.evidence: Several s-like angular returns; last division is insecure and there is no clear detached i dot. Retain sss/ss and allow ssi.

observations.evidence: Main crop: initial D has a looped return followed by u; next word has the low moins sequence, without the tall p descender needed by suppose.
